chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: The funky bass drum beat that only New Orleans had
summary: Danny says St. Louis marching bands lacked the New Orleans bass drum beat that gave jazz its character.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: His father had the Imperial Band, huh? They hung out in St. Louis.
Yeah. Well, he had the Imperial Band and the Elks Band. They had that thing going in St. Louis, too, this marching band. But I don't think they had the funky
bass drum beat that we had here.
Oh, you've got to be here.
Yeah. Well, I don't think they had that. Because it would have been similar... I think Jazz would have been similar if it had had that beat. But that beat is something that you only hear here.
